instagram_note: Handle confirmed via the business's own Fresha profile owner.onlineLinks.instagramUrl. Instagram web_profile_info API returned 401/rate-limited on both attempts (per pipeline: max 2 tries), so bio/media could not be pulled directly; Fresha and the business's own website were used instead.
has_own_site_note: CRITICAL FINDING that overrides the discovery brief: the business DOES have its own website, https://www.bio-beautyskincare.com/ (WordPress, live, phone/address match exactly: (352) 494-1399, 5200 West Newberry Road Suite D-5, Gainesville FL 32607). It is directly linked from the business's own Fresha profile (owner.onlineLinks.websiteUrl). The original discovery only tested biobeautygainesville.com, biobeautyspa.com and biobeautyskincareandwax.com (none resolve) and missed the hyphenated bio-beautyskincare.com. Per PIPELINE.md hard rule #2, has_own_site must be true and the outreach angle must NOT claim 'you don't have a website'; it was changed to a redesign/upgrade pitch.
email_source: Found in the footer/contact text of every page of the business's own website (bio-beautyskincare.com: home, about, contact, waxing, facial-treatments), consistently repeated. Not listed on the Fresha profile itself.
review_summary: At Bio Beauty Skincare and Wax Center, clients rave about the meticulous attention to detail from the estheticians, particularly during services like facials and waxing. Clients appreciate the use of organic and non-toxic products, ensuring a clean and safe experience, while the gentle touch of the therapists makes even the most sensitive treatments, like waxing, nearly painless. The calming atmosphere, complemented by soothing music and comfortable blankets, enhances the overall experience. (Source: Fresha reviewSummary field)
about_source: Bio-beautyskincare.com /about page: mission statement, founder background (Adonalis, career started in South Florida, relocated to Gainesville, operated independently 7 years before building a team), four pillars (quality, personalized care, innovation, holistic approach).
services_note: 40 of 61 total Fresha-listed services shown with exact price/duration (pulled from the venue's __NEXT_DATA__ JSON payload on its Fresha profile page, the 'isMinimal' set of items per category). The remaining ~21 are additional variants not surfaced in that payload; menu heading on the site discloses 'full menu of 61 services' and links to Fresha for the complete list.
